data.rationale: The proposal gets the core procedure right (open event, select ticket count, click Book Now, click Reserve Now), but it leaves out city selection and navigating to Special Events. It also names "event" and "time" as parameters instead of tickets, city and date, and the steps are too vague to automate reliably (no navigation, no concrete ticket value).
